learning_outcomes.text: Students possess vocational knowledge regarding industrial-technical skilled work. They have an overview of the structures, institutions, learning locations, and professional fields of vocational education and training.
Students transfer their acquired knowledge to didactic problems of designing educational and qualification processes.
Students can assess the use of didactic concepts for the design of vocational education processes.
Students apply methods for the analysis of industrial-technical skilled work. Students can assess the use of didactic concepts for the design of vocational education processes.
Students analyze and evaluate structures and challenges of vocational education systems as well as forms and concepts of vocational education and training.

Students can present subjects and structures of vocational education and training. Students can independently study the contents of specialist literature, including in English, and convey them to fellow students and other experts.
Students use technical language, can independently research new literature and assess its relevance. They evaluate the status of their professionalization also in exchange with fellow students.

syllabus_topics: Historical, current, and future development of industrial-technical skilled work
Work-scientific foundations of the analysis and design of work systems and processes
Technical, work-organizational, and personnel requirements for skilled work
Analysis of contents, subjects, and dimensions of vocational work and their impact on the design of education and qualification processes
System of professional fields/groups and recognized training occupations, especially in electrical engineering, information technology, mechatronics, metal and automotive technology
Structures, role, and task of learning locations and institutions of vocational education and training (vocational school, companies, chambers, social partners, associations, etc.)
Introduction to concepts, models, and theories of vocational didactics
Current topics in the design of vocational education and qualification processes (sustainability, heterogeneity, digitalization)
Guiding principles of vocational education and competence models
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a term paper of 12-20 pages. ECTS credits are awarded upon successful completion of this assessment.
